narration: And this is ice mixed into soil, not lakes. And here is the loop I cannot close. Where did it come from?

candidates.title: NGC 7293, the Helix Nebula
candidates.description: NGC 7293, better known as the Helix nebula, displays its ultraviolet glow courtesy of NASA GALEX. The Helix is the nearest example of a planetary nebula, which is the eventual fate of a star, like our own Sun, as it approaches the end of its life.

candidates.title: Comets Kick up Dust in Helix Nebula
candidates.description: This infrared image from NASA Spitzer Space Telescope shows the Helix nebula, a cosmic starlet often photographed by amateur astronomers for its vivid colors and eerie resemblance to a giant eye.

candidates.title: Planetary Nebula NGC 7293 also Known as the Helix Nebula
candidates.description: This ultraviolet image from NASA Galaxy Evolution Explorer is of the planetary nebula NGC 7293 also known as the Helix Nebula.
